integrity: Exact proof and independently formulated numerical checks within this package; no independent expert validation or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The inverse is conditional on a d-dimensional orthotope and exact population distance-CDF coefficients; distinct side lengths are used only for generic sharpness. No finite-sample error guarantee or reconstruction among arbitrary convex bodies. Historical priority of the combined inverse/breakpoint theorem remains provisional, especially due to inaccessible older full texts.
title: Finite-jet distance tomography and the first-break law of Euclidean orthotopes
